# E2E Browser

Use the Playwright configuration and testing standards.

1. Start the Parcel app through `npm start -- --port 4174`.
2. Test routes and the desktop/mobile boundary with meaningful assertions.
3. Exercise the real browser for navigation, rendering, storage, and CSP/header behavior.
4. Avoid screenshots or snapshots as the only assertion.
5. Record browser, viewport, and untestable hardware/provider limitations.
